# llm-structured-output

> Validated structured output from LLM replies into Pydantic models, with linear JSON extraction, string-safe repairs and a bounded re-ask loop Python package `trysac-llm-structured-output`, import name `llm_structured_output`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
